:= by
  have h_injective : Function.Injective (algebraMap R (QuadraticAlgebra R a b)) :=
    QuadraticAlgebra.algebraMap_injective
    
  have h_dvd_iff : ∀ {z w : R}, (algebraMap R (QuadraticAlgebra R a b)) z ∣ (algebraMap R (QuadraticAlgebra R a b)) w ↔ z ∣ w :=
    QuadraticAlgebra.algebraMap_dvd_iff_dvd
    
  have h_nonZeroDivisor_iff : (algebraMap R (QuadraticAlgebra R a b)) r ∈ nonZeroDivisors (QuadraticAlgebra R a b)
    ↔ ¬(∃ s : QuadraticAlgebra R a b, (algebraMap R (QuadraticAlgebra R a b)) r * s = 0) :=
    iff.rfl
    
  have h_zeroProduct_iff : ¬(∃ s : QuadraticAlgebra R a b, (algebraMap R (QuadraticAlgebra R a b)) r * s = 0)
    ↔ ¬(∃ s : R, r * s = 0) :=
    by
      constructor
      · intro h
        rw [QuadraticAlgebra.algebraMap_eq]
        intro s
        rw [QuadraticAlgebra.algebraMap_eq]
        apply h
      · intro h
        intro s
        rw [QuadraticAlgebra.algebraMap_eq]
        exact h s
    
  rw [h_nonZeroDivisor_iff, h_zeroProduct_iff]
  exact iff.rfl
